test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In which year did Mahatma Gandhi organise a satyagraha to support the peasants of the Kheda district?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1918.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Kheda Satyagraha of **1918** was a **satyagraha movement in the Kheda district of Gujarat** in India arranged by **Mahatma Gandhi **through** **the period of the British Raj.
 
• It was a great **revolt in the Indian independence movement.**
 
• It is one of the **revolutionary methods** of freedom fighters.
 
• It was the** third **Satyagraha movement.
 
• [IMAGE: https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcQqU4MR-Tc-cSmcetjxfaJvrzLPcenH-ZhH0g&usqp=CAU] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Khilafat movement was **an agitation by Indian Muslims allied with Indian nationalism in the years following World War I**. ​
 
• Dandi March was **a 24-day non-violent march led by Mahatma Gandhi**.
 
• **The quit India movement** was assumed to be a **peaceful non-violent movement aimed at urging the British to grant India independence.**
